claims.text: Ten of the twelve group-by-area cells were assessed within the engagement window.
Five cells are partial or carry conflicting evidence and are the focus of this report.
Privileged access to the identity platform is the strongest evidenced control in the engagement.
The repository inventory is proposed for the first 90 days.
Two conditions - an unresolved change-record conflict and an access review with no retained record - account for most of the proposed near-term work.
The IAM AI-readiness session cannot be estimated until the cell is assessed.
